For acute DVT or PE without cancer, direct oral anticoagulants are preferred over warfarin as first-line therapy. [ACCP Antithrombotic Therapy for VTE Guideline, 2021]

results.content: For acute deep vein thrombosis or pulmonary embolism without cancer, direct oral anticoagulants are preferred over warfarin as first-line therapy. Anticoagulation duration is at least 3 months, extended indefinitely for unprovoked events with low bleeding risk.
